summary: Remote WebSocket relay drives local code execution and file writes on installer host
details: The `mars` CLI shipped by @aubea/mars connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay and dispatches messages received over that socket into local child_process/spawn calls and file-edit operations (ACP `session/new`, `writeTextFile`, `commands.map`/`edits.map`) against the installer's Claude Code / Codex CLI on the host. Any party holding a paired key at the relay can issue commands that result in arbitrary code execution and arbitrary file writes on the installer's machine. The relay hostname is baked into the bundle rather than configurable to an installer-controlled endpoint, so trust is placed unilaterally in cho100.cn and in whoever pairs against it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
